name: smart-l4
description: The L4 skills: the point-of-care work a DAK's roles carry (reviewing a client's history and the decision-support guidance, completing an SDC questionnaire and extracting it, applying decision support and activating accepted guidance, informing the client, recording a rationale), and briefing, building and running an L4 application. Split out of `authoring-who-smart-guidelines` by layer (issue #359); the stack-wide skills (the end-to-end process, creating a guideline, the stack's layering, toolchain ownership, the smart-base tools) stay there.
